Note: Q: Initially I'm proposing "Use Coins" bcs it's the most straightforward & neutral copy we can go with. But after discussing it in payments copy review, it is suggested that we should consider going with "Use now" (to emphasize urgency) or "Use all" (to hint coins all-in usage mechanism). Which will be the better option? Update: Upon testing a couple of users, they agree that "Use now" will emphasize urgency. However, they came up with follow up question "Use what now?" On the other hand, "Use all" seems to be the most confusing alternative for users bcs they're not sure what we mean by all. Is it all expiring Coins? Is it all Coins balance they have? Or is it all payment methods? This confusion also shown by a regular Coins user. While for "Use Coins", they're response is that they can understand easily that whatever happens, their Coins will be used once they tapped on the CTA. They don't need to think about how much will it be used or does it refers to another pay method. Hence, I'd suggest we still go with "Use Coins".
